info.name: ZoikoTax API (v1)
info.description:
ZoikoTax backend.

STATUS: only /healthz and /readyz exist today. Every /v1 request will 404 until W2 lane K builds the surface — the collection-level test script detects that and skips contract assertions rather than drowning the run in failures.

PAYLOADS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE. ZTAX-INT-001 was not supplied to the specification pipeline (Build Plan §2), so request bodies are derived from the domain model in the ADRs, not from a published contract. When contracts/openapi lands, regenerate this collection from it rather than editing it by hand — ADR-0010 §2.1 makes the contract the source of truth, and a hand-maintained collection is drift waiting to happen.

The folder worth your attention is 07 · Contract conformance. Those requests should fail, in specific ways, and each asserts a control from the ADRs.

item.name: Canonical form · fiscal amount sent as a JSON number

request.description:
netAmount is 45.0 — a JSON number, not a string. Must be rejected, never coerced.

This is the single most important request in the collection. Build Plan §8 rates binary floating-point on fiscal amounts as High risk, and ADR-0011 §1.1 explains why it bites at the evidence layer too: RFC 8785 serializes numbers through IEEE 754 doubles, so a fiscal quantity that is ever a JSON number has already lost precision before canonicalization sees it.

A 2xx response here is a Critical finding, not a test failure.
